judged.play: Streamer introduces the VCT regional finals match between 100 Thieves and LOUD during map vetoes.
judged.line: 100 Thieves, we are getting the job done!
judged.reason: Routine watch party introduction with no gameplay action.

judged.play: Streamer discusses the 100 Thieves player lineup while the broadcast shows the trophy stage.
judged.reason: Background player narrative commentary during pre-game broadcast talk.

judged.play: Streamer gives a pre-match speech about silencing the Brazilian crowd as players set up.
judged.line: We're about to silence this arena!
judged.reason: Pre-game hype speech without any live game action on screen.

judged.play: Split is revealed as map 1, and the streamer excitedly shows off his Phoenix action figurine.
judged.reason: Fun character figure reveal during agent select, but lacks gameplay.

judged.play: Streamer reads out team win percentage statistics on Split before round 1.
judged.reason: Reading pre-match statistical overlays before the match starts.

judged.play: 100T gets wiped early in round 1, leaving Cryo in a 1v3 attempt before LOUD takes the round.
judged.reason: Streamer gets hyped during a 1v3 scenario, but 100 Thieves loses the pistol round.

judged.play: LOUD shuts down 100T's A-site push in the opening pistol round.
judged.reason: Duplicate candidate clip capturing the same pistol round defeat.

judged.play: LOUD secures a flawless round 2 eco-punish while buying Phantoms and Bulldogs.
judged.reason: Standard round commentary reacting to opponent weapon buys.

judged.play: LOUD wins round 3 cleanly to go up 3-0 as 100T struggles to find entry kills.
judged.line: We're getting dropped man, what the heck!
judged.reason: Standard despair reaction to an early round deficit.

judged.play: 100 Thieves gets aggressive kills on B site to win their first round of the match.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF MY FACE BRO!
judged.reason: First round win for 100 Thieves sparks an energetic standing celebration.

judged.play: Cryo hits an Operator pick on mid, prompting a high-pitched squeak from the streamer.
judged.reason: Funny vocal squeak over a single Op kill, but the round lacks a bigger payoff.

judged.play: 100T wins round 6 to trail 2-3, and the streamer breaks down his 'heist' strategy concept.
judged.reason: Distinct and funny monologue framing 100T's comeback attempt as a stealthy heist.

judged.play: 100T plays a slow 2v2 mid-default on Split.
judged.line: It's a 2k, I promise you it's a 2k.
judged.reason: Mid-round play-by-play narration without a high-impact conclusion.

judged.play: Streamer checks the scoreboard and marvels at Eeiu's 11-3 stats.
judged.reason: Amusing stat reaction praising a player, though no live play occurs.

judged.play: LOUD's tuyz pulls off a chaotic 1v3 clutch on B site against 100 Thieves.
judged.line: WHY ARE WE GIVING HIM A 1V3?!
judged.reason: An incredible 1v3 clutch by the opponent triggers a dramatic, passionate breakdown from the streamer.

judged.play: 100 Thieves calls a tactical timeout down 2-5 while the streamer tries to hype them up.
judged.reason: Timeout encouragement speech during a team deficit.

judged.play: Streamer copes through a 100T eco round, claiming it is part of the master plan.
judged.line: It's all part of the plan, ladies and gentlemen.
judged.reason: Routine cope reaction during a low-buy round loss.

judged.play: LOUD extends their lead to 6-2 as the replay plays.
judged.reason: Short, subdued coping reaction after losing another round.

judged.play: Replay shows LOUD's execute as the streamer comments on LOUD's home crowd advantage.
judged.reason: Brief observation on crowd noise during a replay.
